title: Mehran score pour Post-PCI Contrast Nephropathy
formula:
Addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hypotension* | No | 0 |
| Yes | 5 | |
| Intra-aortic balloon pump | No | 0 |
| Yes | 5 | |
| Congestive heart failure** | No | 0 |
| Yes | 5 | |
| Age >75 years | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |
| Anemia*** | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Diabetes | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Contrast media volume | - | 1 point per 100 mL contrast |
| [eGFR](nabda:calc.mdrd-gfr-equation\) , mL/min/1.73 m 2 | ≥60 | 0 |
| 40 to <60 | 2 | |
| 20 to <40 | 4 | |
| <20 | 6 | |

*Systolic blood pressure <80 mmHg for at least 1 hour requiring inotropic support with medications or intra-aortic balloon pump within 24 hours periprocedurally.

**CHF class III/IV by New York Heart Association Classification and/or history of pulmonary edema.

***Baseline hematocrit value <39% for men and <36% for women.

Note: the original study includes serum creatinine (as a dichotomous variable) as an alternative to eGFR, and adds 4 points for Cr >1.5 mg/dL. We have chosen to use eGFR in this calculator as it tends to be a more accurate measure of renal function than creatinine alone.

how_to_use.when: Use in patients undergoing PCI. Do not use in patients with pre-existing end-stage renal disease on dialysis or patients with contrast exposure within 1 week of the index procedure.
how_to_use.pearls: In the[original study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0735109704014457?via%3Dihub), “contrast-induced nephropathy” was defined as an increase ≥0.5 mg/dL (or ≥25%) in pre-PCI serum creatinine at 48 hours post-PCI.

next_steps.advice: Envisager des mesures néphroprotectrices telles que la N-acétylcystéine et la limitation du volume de produit de contraste chez les patients à haut risque de CIN.

more_info:
Interpretation:

| CIN Risk Score | Risk of post-PCI CIN | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Any CIN | CIN requiring dialysis | |
| ≤5 | 7.5% | 0.04% |
| 6-10 | 14.0% | 0.12% |
| 11-15 | 26.1% | 1.09% |
| ≥16 | 57.3% | 12.6% |
medium_description: Prédit le risque de néphropathie induite par le produit de contraste (CIN) après intervention coronarienne percutanée (PCI).

input_schema.name: hypo
input_schema.label: Hypotension
input_schema.tips: SBP <80 for ≥1 hr requiring inotrope or balloon pump within 24 hrs of cath

input_schema.name: chf
input_schema.label: Insuffisance cardiaque congestive
input_schema.tips: Insuffisance cardiaque congestive de classe III/IV selon la classification de la New York Heart Association et/ou antécédent d'œdème pulmonaire

input_schema.name: anemia
input_schema.label: Anemia
input_schema.tips: Hématocrite initial < 39 % chez l'homme et < 36 % chez la femme
